modules.scope: Minimal header-only compiler, invariant, version-value and cache-layout foundation.
modules.non_goals: Runtime version artifact, cache-topology discovery, native FFI and owning-module performance claims.
known_limitations: Compiler hints remain preconditioned and do not guarantee a cache hit or a chosen lowering.
Runtime topology and crash-reporting policy remain with their owning modules.
reopen_triggers: A real consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-foundation defect.
A supported compiler or target invalidates the frozen code-generation contract.
A direct dependency changes Core semantics, or the public component/delivery boundary changes.
A strong peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage for the same consumer contract.

modules.scope: Current auto/safe member-hook intrusive-list capability, C++ API, implementation, direct consumer/dependency, delivery, documentation and P1 engineering evidence.
modules.non_goals: Full owning container, time/scheduler algorithms, reclamation or full intrusive policy matrix, C API/native FFI and Formal release certification.
known_limitations: The component is a 64-bit direct-member, stable-address primitive and fails closed for unsupported pointer-to-data-member representations.
It stores no owner, count, allocator, lock or reclamation metadata; callers own storage, synchronization and business-state mirrors.
Safe-link membership transfer, counted lists and the full Boost.Intrusive policy matrix remain outside the frozen consumer contract.
Engineering performance is qualified only for the frozen W1-WIN contract and retained live artifact bundle; Formal remains PENDING.
reopen_triggers: A named consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-capability defect within this primitive's ownership boundary.
The algorithm, public API, layout, supported compiler ABI, dependency edge or delivery shape changes.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage on a normal consumer workload.
The engineering evidence bundle becomes unavailable, or the frozen contract, peer, machine or instrument identity changes and the claim must be renewed.

modules.scope: Status/Result value model, native adapters, real consumer adoption, C++ source/static/shared delivery, usability/docs and current P1 engineering evidence.
modules.non_goals: Logging, exceptions, arbitrary payload/cause/source-location systems, MultiError, full foreign-category adapters, downstream module closure, native FFI/C API and Formal certification.
modules.blocker: ERR-PERF-NORMAL-01 / status-message-copy: qualified non-inferiority FAIL in all four required strata; the remaining mechanism was not localized after the single permitted product hypothesis. TaskGraph success also retains two UNRESOLVED strata.
modules.blocker_owner: performance-instrument owner for placement diagnosis; error owner only after a concrete product mechanism is proven
modules.resume_condition: A separately scoped instrument task must, without changing the shared-copy copy/destruct charged phase or product API/layout/metadata, produce fail-closed actual heap-address/cache-line and allocation-order sensitivity evidence that either proves a placement confound and freezes a revised contract, or names one concrete product mechanism for a new scoped error RESUME round. n=31 alone, workload substitution, margin relaxation or a second product guess does not resume this module.
known_limitations: Qualified shared owning-message copy is about 8% slower than the fixed same-contract Abseil peer and fails the 5% P1 non-inferiority gate; no whole-module SOTA claim is valid.
TaskGraph all-success propagation retains two UNRESOLVED order/placement strata even though the other two strata pass non-inferiority.
The low-bit header-inline representation requires exactly matching headers and artifacts plus a full consumer rebuild; HYLE does not promise stable C++ ABI or Native FFI in this round.
io and selected sched/container cold-factory adoption decisions remain owned by those module closure rounds.
reopen_triggers: The resume-condition instrument evidence causally classifies the shared-copy gap and supplies either a frozen corrected contract or one concrete product mechanism.
A reproducible correctness, security, ownership, consumer-usability or source/static/shared delivery defect is found within the error boundary.
A direct dependency or supported compiler changes carrier semantics, or a mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class.
